title: exam_state
description: 0.1.23+. The agent's exam mode state. Sent after every `exam_mode` command (also a refused one), when an exam ends at `until`, and once after each connection while an exam runs.

enabled.description: Exam mode is active on the PC now.

since.description: Only while active: start of the exam, Unix seconds (unchanged when a running exam gets new settings).

until.description: Only while active and when the exam has an end time: Unix seconds.

detail.description: Only when the last command could not be applied: why (invalid allow entry, end time in the past, firewall rules not applied or not removed). `enabled` then shows the state that stays in effect.
